summary: Use Node canonical URLs for captured Registry module identity across platforms

delivery.outcome: Canonicalize captured Registry source URLs and the entry URL with Node pathToFileURL, preserve independently pinned byte execution and stdin/argv behavior, and complete Registry Windows CI wiring in immutable standard 0.20.63.
nonGoals: Change Registry public CLI or grant authority
Reopen runtime paths after captured-source verification
Add runtime dependencies, waive Windows identity checks or change unrelated checkouts

architecture.decision: Send raw absolute source paths plus captured independently verified bytes in the bounded frame. Derive source-map and entry URLs consistently in Node through pathToFileURL; preserve original argv and the closed loader. Use byte-exact test fixtures and an explicit tilde/Unicode/percent/hash path regression. Run Registry integrity tests on Windows with fail-closed exit propagation.
interfaceChanges: Add Registry integrity suite to the existing required Windows workflow step; preserve job identities.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material source fix through protected publication; preserve controller and review receipts.

validation.evidence: Ten real Node tests preserve captured pins under entry/dependency mutation, stdin/argv identity and encoded paths; the original implementation fails the explicit tilde-path regression.
Native governance and required Linux, Windows and OneDev checks pass, including Registry identity on Windows.
Independent exact-head protected merge and final immutable standard v0.20.63 release are verified.
